title: AlMehwar Social Intelligence
summary: Connecting fragmented marketing signals into a clearer reporting experience.
challenge: Performance data lived across different channels and reporting surfaces, making it difficult to compare trends consistently.
solution: A consolidated reporting environment for exploring social performance, website insights and campaign comparisons.
role: Analytics logic, dashboard architecture, reporting workflows and AI-assisted implementation.

title: WEDJAT
summary: A marketing intelligence product concept built around connected data and clearer decisions.
challenge: Brands and agencies need a simpler way to make sense of signals spread across multiple marketing tools.
solution: An evolving SaaS experience exploring multi-brand reporting, integrations and AI-assisted recommendations.
role: Product direction, experience design and AI-assisted implementation.

title: Clinics & Appointments
summary: A clearer way for visitors to explore clinics and find the information they need.
challenge: Navigating clinic specialties and schedules can be frustrating when details are difficult to discover.
solution: A responsive directory experience organized around clinics, specialty pages and clear contact pathways.
role: Page planning, experience design and AI-assisted UI implementation.

title: Custom Badge Generator
summary: Turning repetitive badge preparation into a more manageable digital workflow.
challenge: Manually arranging individual photos and details on badges is repetitive and time-consuming.
solution: A tool exploring image upload, image placement, attendee details and export-friendly layouts.
role: Workflow design, interface planning and iterative implementation.

title: Content & Performance Operations
summary: Turning channel-level performance into structured insights for better content decisions.
challenge: High volumes of platform metrics can obscure the lessons behind content performance.
solution: Repeatable approaches to content evaluation, channel reporting and campaign analysis.
role: Social media operations, reporting and interpretation.
